annotations.title: Get quotes: one link to post the trip

description: Call this when the person wants real quotes, prices from operators or to book the trip they planned with you. Returns one short Yippigo link with the trip already filled in (places, date, days, group size, vehicle, notes, and the day-by-day plan when you send `itinerary`: do send it whenever you planned a multi-day trip), a one-line summary, a suitable vehicle with an indicative fare and the number of verified operators near the pickup. The person taps the link, verifies their mobile number once and confirms; verified operators then quote. Nothing is posted or booked until they confirm on Yippigo. Takes no names, phone numbers or emails.

assistant.description: Optional. Which assistant is asking: chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity or other

date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later (India time)

itinerary.description: Optional. The day-by-day plan you made with the person, at most 15 days; send it whenever you planned a multi-day trip so operators can price it.

night_stop.description: Where the group sleeps that night (town or area)

notes.description: One short note for the day (darshan time, early start). No names, phone numbers or emails.

places.description: Places visited that day, in order, place names only (at most 6)

notes.description: Optional trip notes for operators (pickup time, AC, luggage, places to see), at most 300 characters. Never names, phone numbers or emails: they are removed.

vehicle.description: Optional. A vehicle class code (sedan, suv, tt12, tt17, tt26, urbania, minibus32, coach45, coach55) or a kind (car, tempo_traveller, minibus, coach, bus).

name: create_trip_request_link

day_warnings.description: Days of the plan that look too long on the road (soft warnings; the trip is still posted as planned)

expires_at.description: When the short link stops working (7 days)

fare_range.description: Indicative total for the suggested vehicle(s); operators quote the exact price

form_url.description: The prefilled trip form, a fallback for the same trip

summary.description: One line: route, date, days, group size

vehicle.description: A vehicle that suits the group

title: Get quotes: one link to post the trip
